main.summary: Progress snapshot reported by client transfer operations after successful segmented or stream transfer movement.

property.name: TransferFamily
property.summary: Transfer family used for the reported progress event.

property.name: Mode
property.summary: Transfer session mode for the progress event.

property.name: Status
property.summary: Transfer status after the reported progress step completed.

property.name: RealizedBytes
property.summary: Total realized byte count after the reported step.

property.name: RemainingBytes
property.summary: Total remaining byte count after the reported step, or null when the transfer is open-ended.

property.name: LatestRange
property.summary: The most recent accepted or materialized range for this progress event.

property.name: LatestAppendedLength
property.summary: The latest durable appended length when the progress event came from stream transfer.

property.name: StateVersion
property.summary: Transfer state version after the reported step.
